content: PromptPwnd (Aikido, Dec 2025): CI AI agents exploited when prompts embed issue/PR fields and agent holds privileged tokens. GitLost (Noma, Jul 2026) leaked private repo data via public issue. s1ngularity (Nx, Aug 2025): npm postinstall malware invoked local claude/gemini/q CLIs with permission-bypass flags to find and exfiltrate secrets.
